about: Intended differences of the classic renderer, by scene of a regression corpus: the scene id (its path in the corpus), the item of the kernel spec §15 that changed it and its line of the CHANGELOG. scripts/classic_corpus.py verify/compare treat a listed scene that changed as expected and report a listed scene that did not change. The corpus stays outside the repository; only the numbers of its runs are kept here.
